FAQ

Find answers to frequently asked questions.

I am under 19 years old. Can I play at LuckyCasino?

No, you need to be 19 years or older.

When is Customer service available?

Our customer service is available 24/7, every day of the year! No matter when you need assistance, feel free to reach out to us at any time. We're here to help you around the clock, ensuring you receive support whenever you need it!

I have made a withdrawal from LuckyCasino. When do I get my money?

Withdrawals from our end are typically processed within 12 hours. Once the withdrawal has been processed by us, the timeframe for delivery to your card or bank account depends on your card issuer or bank. Interac withdrawals are processed as Real-Time Transfer and cards via the VISA Direct rails. If supported by your issuer or bank, this can result in a near-instant transfer.

Experiencing Location Issues?

If you see a message indicating we can't confirm your location in Ontario, this is likely a location detection problem. Ontario regulations require you to be physically located in Ontario to deposit and play. Location detection problems can happen for several reasons:

You are actually located outside Ontario 
Location services are disabled on your device 
You are near the provincial border 
A VPN or proxy is masking your real location 
Your device's security settings are blocking your IP address 
Cookies have saved a location from a previous visit elsewhere 

Refer to our complete guide for detailed instructions.

Can I set limits to my playing?

Yes, you can at any time go into your account settings and set different kinds of limits such as deposit and loss limits. If you need any help please contact support, we will help you straight away.

Responsible Gambling

This website is for the use of adults in the Province of Ontario, Canada. Individuals must be 19 years of age or older to participate in online casino gaming, in Ontario.  Gambling can be addictive, please play responsibly. ConnexOntario provides service information and resources for people experiencing problems with gambling, drugs, alcohol, or mental health. The service is free, confidential, and available anytime.
